_doc: Episode 'Your data, on your device' of the AI Nutrition Coach videos. Facts: docs/your-data.md, docs/telemetry-posture.md, docs/guide/your-data.md, apps/web/src/i18n/en.ts. Numbers in words, no exclamation marks.

en: Your history lives in one place: an encrypted store in your browser, and on no server.
It is a SQLite database, encrypted with ChaCha20-Poly1305.
The key comes from your passphrase, is held in memory only while unlocked, and is never written to disk.
A wrong passphrase does not open it, and a forgotten one cannot be recovered.
Press Lock, and the store closes at once.
It also locks itself after fifteen idle minutes, or when the page has been hidden for five.
Browsers may clear storage when space runs low, so the app asks yours to keep it, and shows the answer.
So keep an encrypted backup: one file, sealed with a backup passphrase, Argon2id and AES-256-GCM.
It holds your plates, coach notes, saved meals, recipes, profile and language.
Never your AI key, your AI settings or your consents.
Restore it here or on a new device, and it is merged with what is there.
A wrong passphrase or a damaged file changes nothing.
Sync between devices is planned, not built; for now, this file carries your history.
Export writes CSV or JSON: plain, unencrypted files you hold yourself.
You can remove one plate, or erase all local data, behind one confirmation.
The privacy page lists what is stored and what is sent, and there is no telemetry at all.
The details are in the guide.
